entities.name: János Vaszary
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann von Vásáry or János Vaszary (1899–1963) was a Hungarian actor, screenwriter, playwright and film director. Several of his plays were adapted into films including I Entrust My Wife to You in 1943. He was married to the actress Lili Muráti, and the two went into exile in Spain following the Second World War.
